title: The fourth new board
logline: The ramp with a fourth new plank among the three from 2023 and the old gray ones, the pup, eleven, on it. The boy, thirteen, with the drill, from behind. The ramp rebuilt by the one it wasn't built for.

panels.composition: A plank ramp with one fresh pale board among three lighter ones and old gray ones, a boy of thirteen from behind with a drill, an old three-legged dog standing on the ramp.
